LightningComponentBundle.description: Renders the Alphaeon JS SDK in a Visualforce iframe and passes the selected record's details to it.

property.name: componentType
property.label: SDK Component Type
property.description: Which Alphaeon SDK component to render (e.g. customer_status:merchant:badge, checkout:merchant:button).

property.name: environmentOverride
property.label: Environment Override
property.description: Optional. Overrides the environment from the Alphaeon Config metadata for this placement.

property.name: configDeveloperName
property.label: Config Developer Name
property.description: DeveloperName of the Alphaeon Config custom metadata record to use.

property.name: iframeHeight
property.label: Iframe Height (px)
property.description: Height of the embedded SDK iframe in pixels.
